postCaption: Educational content only, not legal or financial advice. Appeal deadlines vary by policy type and state — always confirm your specific plan's terms before relying on any timeline shown here.

slides.headline: Denied? Here's exactly what to do in the first 7 days.
Step 1: Request the denial letter in writing.
slides.body: Verbal denials aren't enough — you need the written reason code to appeal effectively.

slides.headline: Step 2: Find the denial reason code.
slides.body: Every denial letter includes a specific code. This tells you exactly what to challenge.

slides.headline: Step 3: Know your appeal deadline.
slides.body: ⚠ Deadline varies by state and plan type. Check your denial letter, or your state Department of Insurance, before relying on any timeline.

slides.headline: Step 4: Write your appeal.
slides.body: Reference the specific denial code from Step 2. State your case in plain, factual language.

slides.headline: Step 5: Escalate if denied again.
slides.body: If your appeal is denied, your state's Department of Insurance can review the case.

slides.headline: Save this before you need it.
